answer: Under cohort-collision burning, every epoch each identity joining the plume network is hashed into random cohorts of eight, and any same-substrate fingerprint match between two members forces both to burn 2^(matches) deposit units along each thread of evidence, recorded on an append-only trellis. Eight colluding fakes risk up to 28 pairwise collisions, each doubling the burn, so mass Sybil attacks face exponential expected cost (potentially 2^28 units), while one honest agent collides rarely and burns almost nothing.
